newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Komi republic to go on with Eurobond plans.
newsitem.headline: Russian Komi republic to go on with Eurobond plans.

text.p: Russia's northern Komi republic will continue with its plans to issue a Eurobond, Komi Finance Minister Alexander Zakharov said on Thursday.

Komi officials had said previously the republic will issue $200 million in a five-year Eurobond, but the federal Finance Ministry later said Komi could not issue a Eurobond as the republic received funds from the federal budget.
"We do not get money from the federal budget," Zakharov told Reuters. "We earn enough and give 44 percent of revenues to the federal budget."
The federal Finance Ministry was not immediately available for comment.
